import datetime,json,pathlib,subprocess
from inspect import ROOT,WORK,PATCH,PIN,sha,write
before=json.loads((WORK/'before-full.json').read_text())
preflight=json.loads((WORK/'preflight.json').read_text())
log=[]
def command(*args):
 started=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
 p=subprocess.run(args,cwd=ROOT,capture_output=True)
 row=dict(command=list(args),cwd=str(ROOT),startedAtUtc=started,completedAtUtc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),exitCode=p.returncode,stdout=p.stdout.decode(),stderr=p.stderr.decode(),stdoutSha256=sha(p.stdout),stderrSha256=sha(p.stderr))
 log.append(row);write(WORK/'application-commands.json',log)
 print(json.dumps(dict(command=list(args),exitCode=p.returncode,stdout=p.stdout.decode(),stderr=p.stderr.decode())),flush=True)
 if p.returncode:raise RuntimeError('Approved operation failed; dependent actions stopped')
 return p.stdout
if sha(PATCH.read_bytes())!=preflight['approvedPatch']['sha256']:raise RuntimeError('patch changed')
if command('git','rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()!=before['.']['revision']:raise RuntimeError('root advanced')
if sha(command('git','ls-files','--stage'))!=before['.']['indexEntriesSha256']:raise RuntimeError('index changed')
command('git','apply','--index',str(PATCH))
command('git','-c','submodule.recurse=false','-c','fetch.recurseSubmodules=false','submodule','update','--init','--checkout','--','references/Hexalith.Parties')
